scope: Proposition 9.3 of the manuscript “Metric descent and rank-preserving contractions” (preprints/Metric-descent-and-rank-preserving-contractions-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 068 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 35f14f53ac82dc8a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 54. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume fixed-section data (f : X 99K Y, k, s) as in Section 8.1. Let B, B♯ be the integral vertical-minimum divisors of the preceding normal equidimensional graph, and let Ci be its omitted primes. Assume that an integral divisor R and an unbounded sequence of effective divisors satisfy (9.9). Then either a positive multiple of L has a nonzero invariant section on X, or there is a dominant rational map Y 99K Y ′, with dim Y ′ < dim Y , such that its composite with f admits fixed-section data satisfying the regularity and uniqueness conditions of Section 8.1. Its base field is relatively algebraically closed in C(X).
